variations: Short: The pocket mark never faded, but thirteen episodes turned into twenty-four.
Extended: That uniform is still on a hanger, and I prop the phone in front of it to watch a remake of the same show.

items.sourceNote: 連假追劇片單報導提到台韓陸劇一次追完的觀看習慣，原創改編為車上陪看同一集的引述

zh-tw.content:
我表哥載我去機場，車上接著手機在播我推坑給他的那部劇第三十集。
紅燈的時候他把音量轉小，眼睛沒離開後視鏡，說「這集我昨天看過了，我陪你再看一次」。
那句話普通到不像會被記住，可我每次一個人按播放，都會先把音量轉小一格。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個明明看過了、還願意陪你重看一次的人。
variations: 短版：他說「這集我昨天看過了，我陪你再看一次」，我現在按播放都會先轉小音量。
延伸版：那部劇我重看過兩遍，最記得的畫面卻是他手放在排檔上等紅燈。

en.content:
My cousin was driving me to the airport, with episode thirty of the show I'd talked him into playing off his phone.
At a red light he turned the volume down, eyes still on the rearview mirror, and said, "I watched this one yesterday, I'll watch it with you again."
It's too plain a line to be worth keeping, and yet every time I hit play alone I turn the volume down one notch first.
en.editorNote: For the person who already saw the episode and sat through it with you anyway.
variations: Short: He said, "I watched this one yesterday, I'll watch it with you again," and now I turn the volume down before every episode.
Extended: I've rewatched that show twice since, and the picture that stays is his hand on the gearshift at a red light.

items.sourceNote: 下半年台劇片單報導提到長集數戲劇的追看節奏，原創改編為母親在副駕為一句台詞要求延後轉彎

zh-tw.content:
我媽坐在副駕看她那部四十五集的古裝劇，音量開到最大，我一路都在聽劇情。
下交流道前她突然說「你等一下再轉彎，這裡有一句我想聽完」，講完就把手機蓋在腿上。
我從後視鏡瞄到她笑了一下，這句話一點都不特別，但我從此連轉彎都會多等一秒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個曾經為了一句台詞叫你放慢的人。
variations: 短版：她說「你等一下再轉彎，這裡有一句我想聽完」，我從此在那個路口多等一秒。
延伸版：那部劇她早就追完了，車上的音量到今天還停在她調的那一格。

en.content:
My mom rode shotgun watching her forty-five-episode period drama at full volume, so I got the whole plot on the way.
Right before the off-ramp she said, "Hold the turn a second, there's a line I want to hear," and then laid the phone face down on her lap.
In the rearview mirror I caught her smiling, and the line she said was nothing special, but I've been taking that turn one second late ever since.
en.editorNote: For the person who once made you slow down over a single line of dialogue.
variations: Short: She said, "Hold the turn a second, there's a line I want to hear," and I've waited an extra second at that corner ever since.
Extended: She finished the show months ago, and the car stereo is still sitting at the volume she set.

items.sourceNote: 台劇推薦整理提到職人與法律題材的收看熱度，原創改編為同事交接時提到太太追劇的反應

zh-tw.content:
值大夜的同事交接時提到他太太在追的那部律政劇，說他都是被吵醒的那個。
他遞來一杯還溫的豆漿，順口講「她快演到宣判就會抓我手臂，我就知道要醒了」。
我沒追那部，也不認識他太太，可我從那之後看到緊張的段落，會先看旁邊坐著誰。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個在你追到緊張處被你抓過手臂的人。
variations: 短版：同事說「她快演到宣判就會抓我手臂」，我聽完決定不在有人的沙發上追懸疑劇。
延伸版：那杯豆漿早就喝光了，我卻記得他講這句時笑得有點不好意思。

en.content:
The guy handing off the night shift mentioned the legal drama his wife was working through, and said he's the one who gets woken up by it.
He passed me a cup of soy milk still warm and added, "She grabs my arm right before the verdict, that's how I know it's time to wake up."
I wasn't watching that show and I've never met his wife, but ever since, at the tense parts, I check who's sitting next to me first.
en.editorNote: For whoever's arm you have grabbed at the tensest part of an episode.
variations: Short: A coworker said, "She grabs my arm right before the verdict," and I decided never to watch a thriller on a shared couch again.
Extended: The soy milk was long gone, but I still remember how sheepish he looked saying it.

items.sourceNote: 談「再一集就好」心理機制的專文，原創改編為計程車上為了看完一集而希望路變長

zh-tw.content:
計程車司機聽見我手機裡的哭戲，先把冷氣調小一格。
他透過後視鏡問「還剩幾分鐘會演完，我可以開慢一點」，我說大概八分鐘。
那趟車他真的放慢了，八分鐘的路我坐了十一分半。
這句話換誰講都一樣普通，可我現在上車前會先算還剩多久。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合放在你為了看完一集、而希望這條路再長一點的那天。
variations: 短版：司機說「還剩幾分鐘會演完，我可以開慢一點」，那是我第一次希望路上塞車。
延伸版：下車時我才發現他把廣播關了，整段路只有我手機裡的哭聲在響。

en.content:
The taxi driver heard the crying scene coming out of my phone and turned the AC down a notch.
He asked through the rearview mirror, "How many minutes till it ends, I can drive slower," and I said about eight.
He really did slow down, and an eight-minute ride took eleven and a half.
Anyone could have said a line that plain, but now I check how much is left before I get in a car.
en.editorNote: For the day you wished the ride were longer just so you could finish the episode.
variations: Short: The driver said, "How many minutes till it ends, I can drive slower," and it was the first ride I ever hoped would hit traffic.
Extended: Getting out, I noticed he'd switched the radio off, so the whole ride was just the crying from my phone.

items.sourceNote: 追劇心理學專文談自動播放與懸念如何延長觀看時間，原創改編為雨天把音量一再調高的午後畫面

zh-tw.content:
西北雨從三點半下到現在，我把窗戶推開一條縫，讓風進來。
桌上那個底片盒被吹到地上，我沒去撿，讓它滾到床腳，接著看第十四集。
雨聲蓋過耳機，我把音量往上加了兩格，過一會兒又加兩格。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在雨一直沒停、你也一直沒關掉自動播放的那個午後。
variations: 短版：雨從三點半下到現在，底片盒滾到床腳，我把音量再加兩格。
延伸版：雨小下來的時候，地板上多了一圈水痕，底片盒還躺在原本滾去的地方。

en.content:
The afternoon rain started at three thirty and hasn't let up, so I pushed the window open a crack and let the air in.
The film canister on the desk blew onto the floor, and I left it there, let it roll to the foot of the bed, and started episode fourteen.
The rain was louder than my earbuds, so I nudged the volume up two notches, then two more a while later.
en.editorNote: For the afternoon when the rain didn't stop and neither did autoplay.
variations: Short: The rain hasn't let up since three thirty, the film canister rolled to the foot of the bed, and I turned it up two more notches.
Extended: When the rain eased off there was a ring of water on the floor, and the canister was still where it had rolled.

items.sourceNote: 追劇心理學報導談一集接一集的機制，原創改編為濕冷傍晚讓劇繼續播下去的畫面

zh-tw.content:
濕氣重到牆壁摸起來是涼的，我把電風扇轉到最小，對著沙發吹。
劇裡那對男女在江邊講分手，我伸手摸到桌角的底片盒，把它壓在遙控器上。
外面的雨一陣一陣，我把毯子拉到下巴，再點下一集。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在濕答答的傍晚，什麼都不想做、只想讓劇一直播下去的時候。
variations: 短版：雨一陣一陣，我把毯子拉到下巴，底片盒壓著遙控器沒動。
延伸版：隔天早上牆壁還是涼的，底片盒仍然壓在遙控器上，劇已經播到第五集。

en.content:
The damp is heavy enough that the wall feels cool under my hand, so I set the fan to its lowest speed and pointed it at the couch.
On screen the two of them were breaking up by the river, and I felt around for the film canister on the corner of the desk and set it down on the remote.
The rain outside came in waves, and I pulled the blanket up to my chin and tapped the next episode.
en.editorNote: For a muggy evening when the only plan is to let the next episode load.
variations: Short: The rain came in waves, I pulled the blanket up to my chin, and the film canister stayed put on the remote.
Extended: The wall was still cool the next morning, the canister was still on the remote, and the show had run to episode five.

items.sourceNote: 追劇心理學編譯文談沉浸與連續觀看，原創改編為午後光線一直變、人卻沒起身的畫面

zh-tw.content:
起風的時候太陽還在，地板上那塊亮的正好落在螢幕邊。
我站起來把窗簾拉到三分之二，坐回去，順手把亮度往下調一格。
雲飄過來，地板暗了，我沒有動，第九集的片頭剛好跑完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在光線一直變、你卻連姿勢都沒換過的下午。
variations: 短版：起風的時候我把窗簾拉了三分之二，雲飄過來以後就一直沒拉開。
延伸版：天黑之後我才注意到亮度還停在下午調低的那一格。

en.content:
The wind picked up while the sun was still out, and the bright patch on the floor landed right at the edge of the screen.
I got up and drew the curtain two-thirds across, sat back down, and knocked the brightness down a notch.
A cloud came over, the floor went dark, I didn't move, and the opening credits of episode nine had just finished.
en.editorNote: For the afternoon when the light kept changing and you never changed position.
variations: Short: I drew the curtain two-thirds across when the wind picked up, and after the clouds came it stayed that way.
Extended: After dark I noticed the brightness was still on the notch I set that afternoon.

items.sourceNote: 2026 韓劇推薦整理提到一追上癮的觀看節奏，原創改編為寒流早晨重按同一集開頭的畫面

zh-tw.content:
寒流那幾天我把電暖器搬到床邊，插頭沒拔過。
早上窗戶全是白霧，我用手背抹出一塊，看得到對面樓還沒亮燈。
劇停在昨晚睡著的地方，進度條上剩一小段沒走完。
我把被子拉高，從那一集的開頭重新按下去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在冷到不想起床、卻願意為了一集重按播放的早上。
variations: 短版：早上窗戶結霧，我抹開一塊，回頭把昨晚沒看完的那一集重按一次。
延伸版：電暖器嗡嗡響到中午，劇裡的雪也一直沒停。

en.content:
During the cold snap I moved the space heater next to the bed and never unplugged it.
In the morning the window was white with condensation, so I wiped a patch clear with the back of my hand and could see the lights still off in the building across the way.
The show had stopped where I fell asleep last night, with a short stretch of the progress bar left to run.
I pulled the covers up and started that episode again from the top.
en.editorNote: For the morning it's too cold to get up but not too cold to restart the episode.
variations: Short: The window had fogged over, I wiped a patch clear, then restarted the episode I'd slept through.
Extended: The heater hummed until noon, and the snow in the show never let up either.

items.sourceNote: 陸劇餘韻主題整理文提到看完走不出來的觀劇狀況，原創改編為等家人練完琴、畫面停在原處的場面

zh-tw.content:
琴盒放在沙發旁邊，松香那盒蓋子沒關緊，白粉掉了一點在坐墊上。
我姊那時候把手機架在譜架上，說了一句，你先看，我拉完這段就過去。
她拉完那段已經是四十分鐘後，我停在同一個畫面沒往下按。
現在我自己看到要接的地方，會先問旁邊的人還要多久。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家裡有人在練琴、你等到一集都沒往下走的時候。
variations: 短版：琴盒旁邊那盒松香沒關緊，我等她拉完那段，畫面停在原處。
延伸版：坐墊上的白粉擦掉以後，我還是習慣先問一句你多久。

en.content:
The violin case sat beside the sofa, the little tin of rosin wasn't shut properly, and some white powder had fallen onto the cushion.
My sister propped her phone on the music stand back then and said, go ahead and watch, I'll come over once I get through this passage.
She got through that passage forty minutes later, and I was still parked on the same frame without pressing on.
These days, when I reach a part I'd rather not reach alone, I ask the person next to me how long they'll be.
en.editorNote: For when someone at home is practicing and you wait a whole episode without moving.
variations: Short: The tin of rosin by the case was open, I waited out her passage, and the frame stayed where it was.
Extended: The powder wiped off the cushion, and I still start by asking how long you'll be.

items.sourceNote: 2026 韓劇盤點文列出整年待追清單，原創改編為一件沒用途的小東西跟著換過幾台電視的畫面

zh-tw.content:
國中同學搬走前把一小塊松香塞給我，說，這個不會壞，你留著。
我沒有琴，就把它擱在電視櫃上面，看劇的時候偶爾聞得到一點味道。
上個月換電視，那塊東西被我從灰塵裡挖出來，包裝紙已經黃了。
新的機器裝好那晚，我把它放回原來的位置才開始播。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合一件沒有用途的小東西，跟著你換過好幾台電視。
variations: 短版：那小塊松香擱在電視櫃上好幾年，換機器那晚我又把它放回去。
延伸版：包裝紙黃到看不出字，味道倒是還留著一點。

en.content:
Before he moved away, a classmate from junior high pushed a small block of rosin into my hand and said, this stuff doesn't go bad, keep it.
I don't play anything, so I left it on top of the TV cabinet, and while watching I would catch a faint smell of it now and then.
Last month I changed the television and dug the thing out of the dust, its wrapper gone yellow.
The night the new set was installed, I put it back where it used to sit before I hit play.
en.editorNote: For the useless little object that has followed you through several televisions.
variations: Short: That small block of rosin sat on the cabinet for years, and I put it back the night the new set arrived.
Extended: The wrapper yellowed past reading, though a bit of the smell was still there.

items.sourceNote: 連假追劇懶人包整理長時間觀看的節奏，原創改編為室友半夜經過門口只講五個字的片段

zh-tw.content:
室友半夜經過我房門口，只說了五個字，記得吃東西。
她手上端著自己的碗，腳步沒有停，門也沒推開。
桌上那包餅乾我隔了兩天才拆，配著第五集吃完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合半夜有人經過門口，講完一句就走的那種同住關係。
variations: 短版：她端著碗經過門口，說完五個字就走了。
延伸版：餅乾拆開的時候，劇已經演到第五集。

en.content:
My roommate passed my door in the middle of the night and said only four words, remember to eat something.
She was carrying her own bowl, her steps didn't slow, and the door stayed shut.
I didn't open that packet of crackers on the table until two days later, and finished it during episode five.
en.editorNote: For the kind of housemate who passes your door at night, says one line, and keeps walking.
variations: Short: She went past the door with her bowl, said four words, and kept going.
Extended: By the time the crackers were open, the show had reached episode five.

items.sourceNote: 長期更新的韓劇評價清單顯示追劇是跨年度的習慣，原創改編為家人記不住劇名卻年年問進度的通話

zh-tw.content:
我媽在電話裡問完晚餐，補了一句，你那個演完了沒。
她從來記不住劇名，只用那個代替，我也沒糾正過。
上禮拜大結局，我看完隨手回撥，響兩聲就掛掉，怕太晚吵到她。
隔天她先傳訊息來，句子一字都沒改。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家人記不住劇名、卻每次都問你追到哪裡的通話。
variations: 短版：我媽只會問你那個演完了沒，從來不講劇名。
延伸版：回撥響兩聲就掛掉，隔天她照樣先傳訊息過來。

en.content:
On the phone my mother finished asking about dinner and added, is that thing of yours over yet.
She has never kept a drama title in her head and just says that thing, and I have never corrected her.
The finale aired last week, I called back right after watching, then hung up after two rings in case it was too late for her.
The next day she messaged first, and the sentence hadn't changed by a word.
en.editorNote: For the call where a relative can't recall the title but always asks how far along you are.
variations: Short: My mother only asks whether that thing of yours is over, never using the title.
Extended: I hung up after two rings, and the next day she messaged first anyway.

items.sourceNote: 追劇對心靈有益的研究整理文提到長時間投入故事後的回想，原創改編為看劇時手上必須有東西可繞的習慣

zh-tw.content:
布莊老闆問我要幾碼，我說先給我三碼。
那捲滾邊條回家就擱在沙發扶手上，看劇的時候我把它繞成一球。
第七集演到一半球就繞完了，我從另一頭拆開，再繞一次。
隔天我又去買了三碼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合看劇時手上一定要有東西可以繞、可以捏的人。
variations: 短版：那捲滾邊條被我繞成球又拆開，一集拆兩次。
延伸版：三碼撐不完一部劇，所以我固定每週補一次貨。

en.content:
The man at the fabric shop asked how many yards, and I said three to start.
The roll of bias binding ended up on the arm of the sofa, and I wound it into a ball while the show played.
Halfway through episode seven the ball was done, so I unpicked it from the far end and wound it a second time.
Next day I went back for another three yards.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose hands need something to wind or squeeze while a show is on.
variations: Short: That roll of bias binding gets wound into a ball and undone twice an episode.
Extended: Three yards never lasts a whole series, so I restock every week.

items.sourceNote: 追劇心理學專文談觀眾對角色的投入程度，原創改編為把畫面暫停下來研究戲服細節的行為

zh-tw.content:
我把畫面停在女主角的袖口，用手機拍了一張。
隔天拿去布莊比對，想找出一樣的滾邊條。
老闆娘翻出四種讓我挑，每一種我都剪一小段帶走，回家排在遙控器旁邊。
那部劇我沒看完，四小段都還在。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合為了一個畫面細節，真的跑一趟店裡的人。
variations: 短版：為了袖口那圈滾邊條，我剪了四種顏色回家比。
延伸版：劇停在第九集，四小段還照原本的順序排著。

en.content:
I froze the picture on the lead actress's cuff and took a photo of it with my phone.
The next day I carried that photo to the fabric shop, hoping to match the bias binding.
The owner pulled out four kinds for me, I had a short piece cut from each, and at home they went in a row beside the remote.
I never finished the drama. Those four pieces are still there.
en.editorNote: For the person who will actually make a trip to a shop over one detail on screen.
variations: Short: Four colors of bias binding came home with me, all for one cuff on screen.
Extended: The drama stopped at episode nine; the four pieces are still in their original order.

items.sourceNote: 追劇心理學文章談自動播放與角色認同，原創改編為重看同一部劇時固定跳過與固定不跳過的兩種堅持

zh-tw.content:
這部我看到第五輪，每輪都從第三集開始，因為前面兩集那個人還沒出現。
片頭曲我沒有跳過的習慣，跳掉會少一分半，那一分半我要。
上禮拜同事問我最近在看什麼新的，我說很新。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合重看同一部劇、而且有一整套固定流程的人。
variations: 短版：第五輪了，還是從第三集開播，片頭曲一秒都不跳。
延伸版：同事問我在看什麼新的，我的回答技術上沒有錯。

en.content:
This is my fifth time through, and every round starts at episode three, because the person I watch it for isn't on screen before that.
Skipping the opening theme is not something I do; skipping costs a minute and a half, and I want that minute and a half.
A coworker asked last week what new thing I was on, and I said it was very new.
en.editorNote: For rewatchers who have a whole fixed procedure around it.
variations: Short: Round five, still opening at episode three, still not skipping one second of the theme.
Extended: My coworker asked what was new, and technically my answer holds up.

items.sourceNote: 談完結欲與追劇停不下來的心理學報導，原創改編為自己做一個裝置想擋住睡前再看一集的念頭

zh-tw.content:
睡前手機要收進床尾那個布袋，袋口那圈滾邊條是我自己車歪的，拉開會卡住。
卡住的那兩三秒，剛好夠我決定要不要再開一集。
昨天晚上我拉開了七次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合替自己設計過某種睡前裝置、然後每晚繞過它的人。
variations: 短版：袋口車歪的那圈滾邊條，一晚被我拉開七次。
延伸版：那兩三秒本來是留給我改變主意用的。

en.content:
Before sleep the phone goes into the cloth pouch at the foot of the bed, whose opening is edged with bias binding I sewed on crooked, so it catches when you pull.
Those two or three catching seconds are just enough time to decide whether to start another episode.
Last night I pulled it open seven times.
en.editorNote: For anyone who built themselves a bedtime device and then walks around it nightly.
variations: Short: The crooked bias binding on that pouch got pulled open seven times in one night.
Extended: Those couple of seconds were supposed to be where I changed my mind.

items.sourceNote: 報導串流平台整季下載、供離線觀看的功能，原創改編為一張欄位式便條：下架日與上山行程撞在同一天

zh-tw.content:
下架日：這禮拜天半夜十二點，平台把那部片子收回去。
還剩幾集：六集，每集五十分鐘，我算過，來得及。
同一天要出門：上山，冰爪已經塞進背包側袋。
山上收不收得到訊號：沒查，查了也是那個答案。
所以：先看四集，剩下兩集等下山，離線那份還撐得住。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合把行程和片單寫在同一張紙上、然後兩邊都想顧的人。
variations: 短版：下架日跟出發日同一天，冰爪先塞好，四集先看掉。
延伸版：離線那份撐得住幾天，我背下來了，山上的天氣預報反而沒背。

en.content:
Comes down: this Sunday at midnight, when the platform takes that show back.
Episodes to go: six, fifty minutes each, I did the math, it fits.
Leaving the same day: up the mountain, crampons already stuffed in the side pocket.
Signal up there: didn't look it up, looking it up gives the same answer.
So: four episodes now, the last two after I'm down, the offline copy will hold.
en.editorNote: For people who keep their trip and their watchlist on one sheet of paper and try to serve both.
variations: Short: Removal day and departure day landed together, crampons packed, four episodes cleared first.
Extended: I memorized how long the offline copy lasts; the mountain forecast I did not.

items.sourceNote: 玉山國家公園的冬攀裝備清單（冰斧、冰爪、頭燈等）與行前檢查表，原創改編為一張兩次書寫、字跡變小的手寫留言

zh-tw.content:
桌上那張紙先不要丟。
上面那行是鉛筆寫的：星期四凌晨兩點就沒了，我還差三集。
下面那行是後來補上去的：星期四也要出發，冰爪跟頭燈放在鞋櫃上層，不要壓到。
兩行同一支筆，中間隔了四天，字有變小。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合同一張紙寫兩次、而且自己看得出來心情變了的人。
variations: 短版：同一張紙、同一支筆，隔四天寫的字比較小。
延伸版：鉛筆寫的那行我沒有擦掉，因為三集後來變成五集。

en.content:
Leave the paper on the table where it is.
Top line, in pencil: gone at two in the morning on Thursday, and I'm three episodes short.
The line under it went on later: I leave Thursday too, crampons and headlamp are on the upper shelf of the shoe rack, don't crush them.
Same pencil for both, four days apart, and the letters came out smaller.
en.editorNote: For anyone who wrote on the same scrap twice and can see their own mood change in it.
variations: Short: One scrap, one pencil, and the writing four days later came out smaller.
Extended: I never erased the pencil line, because three episodes turned into five.

items.sourceNote: 串流平台說明下載內容會過期、且已不在平台上的片無法重新下載，原創改編為貼在自己門後、只給自己看的一張公告

zh-tw.content:
這張是我自己張貼在門後的，一式一份，沒有要給誰看。
到期日：九月十四號，那天以後這部就不在這裡了。
目前進度：第九集開頭，畫面暫停在有人講電話。
打算怎麼辦：還沒想到。
哪天這張紙撕下來，代表我看完了，或者代表我不看了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合把追劇進度寫成公告貼給自己看、卻遲遲沒撕的人。
variations: 短版：公告貼在門後，一式一份，讀者只有我一個。
延伸版：撕下來的那天我不會通知任何人，因為兩種結局長得一樣。

en.content:
I taped this on the back of my own door, one copy, for no one.
Gone after: September fourteenth, and then it isn't here anymore.
Where I am: start of episode nine, frozen on someone taking a call.
What I'll do: haven't worked that out.
The day this paper comes down means I finished it, or means I quit it.
en.editorNote: For people who post their own progress as a notice to themselves and never take it down.
variations: Short: A notice on the back of the door, one copy, readership of one.
Extended: Nobody gets told when it comes down, because both endings look identical.

items.sourceNote: 登山行前裝備檢查（含冰爪綁帶是否鬆脫）的官方建議，原創改編為門把上的倒數字條：裝備與片單並列，只有一項會做完

zh-tw.content:
剩四天，字條掛在門把上。
沒開的片還有兩部，一部十集一部十六集；冰爪的綁帶昨天擦到一半發現鬆了，得換。
這兩件事寫在同一張紙上，只有一件會在四天內做完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合同時欠一份裝備和一份片單、而且心裡有數的人。
variations: 短版：門把上那張紙寫了兩件事，四天內只做得完一件。
延伸版：綁帶換掉只要十分鐘，二十六集要幾天我不敢算。

en.content:
Four days left, and the note hangs off the door handle.
Two shows still unopened, one at ten episodes and one at sixteen; halfway through wiping the crampons yesterday I found a strap gone slack, so it has to be swapped.
Both of those sit on the same scrap of paper, and only one gets finished in four days.
en.editorNote: For anyone who owes a gear list and a watchlist at once and already knows how it ends.
variations: Short: Two jobs on the note by the door, and four days buys exactly one of them.
Extended: Swapping the strap takes ten minutes; twenty-six episodes takes a number I won't work out.
